pieces.tagline: Ethereal depths captured in a textured golden frame.
pieces.name: Aether
pieces.story:
Aether I is a quiet meditation on clarity and shadow, defined by the interplay of deep, lustrous stones and hand-hammered metal. The design evokes a sense of ancient wisdom, where the organic warmth of the frame cradles the mysterious, shifting hues of the natural gems. It is a piece designed for the wearer who finds beauty in the subtle nuances of light and the tactile history of the maker's hand.

  

Handcrafted via the traditional lost-wax technique by a single master artisan, this limited-edition artefact bridges the gap between antiquity and contemporary edge. Every shadow and contour is born from a deliberate strike of the hammer; the surface marks are preserved as the proud signature of the maker—serving as tangible proof of a human touch in a machine-made age.

pieces.tagline: Architectural precision reimagined as a modern, brutalist form.
pieces.name: Structura
pieces.story:
Structura I is a study in geometry and tension, designed for those who view adornment as an extension of architectural form. With its bold, open-work silhouette and intricate, mesh-like surface texture, this piece captures the raw energy of modern construction softened by a human touch. It is an exploration of space and light, creating a dynamic presence on the hand that challenges traditional notions of jewellery.

  

Handcrafted via the traditional lost-wax technique by a single master artisan, this limited-edition artefact bridges the gap between industrial edge and refined grace. Every shadow and contour is born from a deliberate strike of the hammer; the surface marks are preserved as the proud signature of the maker—serving as tangible proof of a human touch in a machine-made age.

pieces.tagline: An ode to the ocean's hidden treasures, sculpted into a golden reverie.
pieces.name: Marina
pieces.story:
Marina I serves as a poetic tribute to the ocean’s depth, capturing the delicate, intricate beauty of coral and shell formations. The design creates a dreamlike landscape on the hand, where natural, luminous stone is cradled by hand-shaped metal that mimics the organic rhythm of the sea. It is a piece for those who carry the serenity and mystery of the tides with them, finding elegance in the intricate details of nature.

Every shadow and contour is born from a deliberate strike of the hammer; the surface marks are preserved as the proud signature of the maker—serving as tangible proof of a human touch in a machine-made age.

pieces.tagline: The ocean's silent depths, frozen in a golden, organic embrace.
pieces.name: Marina II
pieces.story:
Marina II continues our poetic exploration of the ocean’s hidden realms. Where its counterpart celebrates the light, this iteration embraces the allure of the deep—featuring a central stone that mirrors the mysterious, shifting tones of twilight waters. Cradled by intricate coral and shell formations, the design feels like a relic recovered from a forgotten seabed, transformed into a piece of modern, wearable art.
